title: Repository lifecycle final identity and exact-head approval guard

phases.objective: Fail closed unless repository finalization proves an open non-Draft pull request, unchanged exact head and base identities, complete exact-head human approval evidence, and a separately authorized Ready state immediately before the merge request.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Only an open non-Draft pull request with unchanged approved head and base SHAs, no active exact-head changes request, and sufficient non-author human approval can reach PUT /pulls/{number}/merge.
steps: Run the required-check, mergeability, Draft-state, and base-freshness gate for the exact candidate.
Re-read pull-request state, Draft status, head SHA, and base SHA before collecting review evidence.
Reject stale-head, bot, author, dismissed, non-decisive, incomplete, or changes-requested review evidence.
Require the configured exact-head non-author human approval quorum.
Re-read state, Draft status, head SHA, and base SHA after approval evidence and immediately before merge.
Keep mark_ready absent from automatic pr_delivery and full_workstream finalization templates.
assertions: A Ready-to-Draft race fails with github_pr_finalize_draft_blocked before any merge request.
Initial final identity drift fails with github_pr_finalize_final_identity_mismatch and validation_phase=final_pre_merge_readback before review retrieval or merge.
Post-approval state, Draft, head, or base drift fails with validation_phase=post_approval_pre_merge_readback before merge.
Only latest exact-head APPROVED reviews from non-bot non-author humans count toward quorum.
The merge request remains bound to expected_head_sha and cannot be reached by a stale base identity.
Automatic finalization plans do not mark a Draft pull request Ready in the same operation.

phases.objective: Bind exact approval evidence to immutable audit records and separately issued protected-finalization capability envelopes.
Prove fail-closed behavior across merge queues, review pagination boundaries, retries, and concurrent Ready/Draft or base updates.
Repository lifecycle finalization has no provider canary authority.
This guard grants no Production, deployment, provider, database, migration, credential, or external-send authority.
